title: Velvety Adventurous Chinese Turkey Neck Braised
description: A pungent, savory, and velvety Hunan-inspired dish featuring turkey neck with a touch of yuzu-cure. The rich, savory flavors pair perfectly with steamed bok choy or rice.

ingredients.name: Turkey necks (4-6)
ingredients.notes: You can also use a combination of necks and giblets for added flavor.

ingredients.name: Szechuan peppercorns
ingredients.notes: Toast in a dry pan for added depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: Yuzu juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh yuzu juice for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Dark soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality soy sauce for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality soy sauce for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Hoisin sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality hoisin sauce for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Cornstarch
ingredients.notes: Mix with a small amount of water to create a slurry.

instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic, ginger, and Szechuan peppercorns and cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the turkey necks and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the yuzu juice, dark soy sauce, soy sauce, and hoisin sauce to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the turkey is tender and falls off the bone.
Remove the turkey from the pot and let it cool slightly.
Shred the turkey with two forks and return it to the pot.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
